description.en: The UID of the member account.

description.zh:
VPC 边界防火墙的实例 ID。取值：

- VPC 边界防火墙防护云企业网内的网络实例时，实例 ID 使用云企业网实例 ID。云企业网基础版通过调用[DescribeVpcFirewallCenList](~~345777~~) 接口，查询云企业网的实例 ID。云企业网企业版通过调用 [DescribeTrFirewallsV2List ](~~2384695~~) 接口，查询云企业网的实例 ID。
- VPC 边界防火墙防护通过高速通道连接的两个 VPC 之间的流量时，实例 ID 使用 VPC 边界防火墙实例 ID。您可以通过调用  [DescribeVpcFirewallList](~~342932~~) 接口，查询 VPC 边界防火墙的实例 ID。
description.en:
The instance ID of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

- If the VPC firewall protects a network instance in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, set this parameter to the ID of the CEN instance. To query the ID of a CEN instance of Basic Edition, call the [DescribeVpcFirewallCenList](~~345777~~) operation. To query the ID of a CEN instance of Enterprise Edition, call the [DescribeTrFirewallsV2List](~~2384695~~) operation.

- If the VPC firewall protects traffic between two VPCs connected by an Express Connect circuit, set this parameter to the ID of the VPC firewall instance. To query the ID of the VPC firewall instance, call the [DescribeVpcFirewallList](~~342932~~) operation.

title.zh: 获取指定VPC边界防火墙的入侵防御配置信息

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于获取指定VPC边界防火墙的入侵防御配置信息，需要先完成创建VPC防火墙实例。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation queries the intrusion prevention configuration of a specified VPC firewall. Before you call this operation, you must create a VPC firewall instance.

## QPS limit

This API operation has a limit of 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. If you exceed this limit, your calls are throttled. This may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.
